changelog: Say "redo" — in English or Bengali ("আবার করো") — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the last undone segment comes back exactly where the undo took it from, the hands-free twin of the voice "undo", for a segment removed by mistake without re-dictating it. Only the most recent undo can be redone, and typing or moving the cursor since the undo makes redo refuse instead of putting the words in the wrong place. Saying the word inside a longer sentence still types it as normal text.
